name: Qwopus3.8-27B-Coder-Flash

lineage.how_derived: community fine-tune for coding, agentic reasoning and tool use

purpose: Coding-oriented 'Flash' model for practical software work: make a concrete change, inspect tool feedback, test, recover (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; LICENSE file present but text not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, hidden 5120, head dim 256

variants.notes: GGUF repo Jackrong/Qwopus3.8-27B-Coder-Flash-GGUF exists, sizes not checked

pc-12gb.variant: Q4_K_M by analogy to Arete-27B (17.2 GB); GGUF repo not checked
pc-12gb.notes: 17.2 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

benchmarks.name: MMLU-Pro (local subset: 500 math, 500 physics, 500 chemistry, zero-shot CoT)
benchmarks.variant: BF16; builder's own 1,500-question subset, not the full benchmark

weaknesses: no standard coding benchmark in the part read; the one score is a self-chosen STEM subset, not a coding measure

tona_fit.reason: A community coding fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B without a standard coding or agentic benchmark; no reason to prefer it over the stock model or the RL variants until measured.
